adapters: Actual B1B850 all-used mask scan/clear, single CRT draw modulo u16 count, cursor and optional descriptor update, selected-byte mark and initial cycle-completed result execute. CRT returns qualified Microsoft sequence values.
findings: Selection does not exclude previously used indices; repeats remain possible. Returned cycle-completed reflects mask before selection. Only count bytes are cleared, padding remains owned unchanged.
limits: Nonempty owned masks/count1/2/3/8 only. Native zero count IDIV0 and null masks for nonzero count are separately prepared in24 native fault cases and require explicit Rust error/fault mapping, not normal success. Shared RNG and normal mask/path constructors and Rust replay/integration remain required.
